marketBrief.headline: Futures slide before the bell as Amazon and Intel extend Thursday's tech selloff
marketBrief.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures were down 2.65% and S&P 500 futures down 1.13% in premarket quotes, after Alphabet's 12.7% Thursday drop. Amazon fell after hours on an earnings miss and Intel fell premarket on weak Q4 guidance. The 8:30 a.m. Employment Cost Index and Sanofi's Q3 webcast are the scheduled catalysts.
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures at 28,780, down 2.65%; S&P 500 futures at 7,666.25, down 1.13%; Dow futures at 52,520, up 0.02% (Business Insider premarket, 7:51 a.m. ET).
Amazon fell more than 6% after hours after EPS of $1.89 missed $1.96 expected; AWS revenue rose to $45.98 billion (CNBC).
Intel was down about 26% premarket after guiding Q4 revenue to $15B-$16B, below the $17.05B consensus (Seeking Alpha).
WTI crude was up 1.96% at $104.00 and Brent up 2.72% at $118.00 premarket; gold down 1.45% (Business Insider).
8:30 a.m. ET: Employment Cost Index (Bureau of Labor Statistics) and Sanofi Q3 webcast (Sanofi).

calendar.why: Compensation trends help markets gauge services inflation and labor-cost pressure (Bureau of Labor Statistics).
Results against a $1.63 consensus EPS estimate; pipeline and guidance are the focus (Sanofi IR; MarketBeat).
Apple reports after the close; the next major test of the consumer-hardware and services outlook (Apple Investor Relations).
Control of Congress can reshape expectations for taxes, regulation and fiscal policy.
Payrolls, unemployment and wages will shape expectations for the Fed's next steps.
CPI is a key cross-check on inflation after the Fed meeting.
Next scheduled GDP update after the Oct 29 advance estimate (Bureau of Economic Analysis).
Traders priced about 84% odds of a quarter-point hike after the Oct. 28 hold, per CME FedWatch via Investopedia.
